why: L2.content-repetition: a clause restated in the same breath with nothing added.
behaviour: the speaker restates one or two points in the same breath with no new information, as people do while thinking aloud ("I need to pick up a parcel from the post office. I need to pick up a parcel from the post office and I also need to go to the pharmacy.")
rule: Remove a point the speaker restates with no added information, keeping the fullest version once and any new detail the restatement adds.
